A headerless table whose rows have different cell counts is padded, not turned into a list

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#include "html_to_markdown.h"

int main(void) {
    HTMAlefHandle result = htm_convert("<table><tr><td>A</td><td>B</td></tr><tr><td>C</td></tr></table>", 0);
    htm_conversion_result_free(result);
```
